subject: Mutual onboarding: term tweak, burst runway, and ops playbook
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example>
To: Alex Day <alex.day@starlift.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example>
Date: 2029-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual onboarding: term tweak, burst runway, and ops playbook

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week. Per our call we sketched a compact mutual action plan so Starlift can both extend the current term and add a short burst runway for the upcoming holiday peak. High level:

- Term: 12-month renewal with an option for a 3-month extension at pre-negotiated rates
- Capacity: +40% burst buffer for Nov–Dec, with automatic throttling policies to protect steady-state SLOs
- Ops playbook: QBR cadence, escalation contact list, and rollback policy for model variants

I've attached a first-pass Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx and a QBR_agenda_draft.docx. Can you confirm the list of stakeholders on your side and whether the week of Aug 12 (Aug 12–16) works for a kickoff QBR? If that window is tight, propose an alternative and we'll adjust.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm procurement contact and DocuSign lead
2) Redwood to deliver security artifacts (SOC2, retention policy) by Jul 24
3) Align on QBR date and send calendar invite

Ben/Evelyn — looping you in for pricing/ops readiness and security docs.

Thanks —
Mina

Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.example | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), QBR_agenda_draft.docx (doc)
From: Alex Day <alex.day@starlift.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example>
Cc: Starlift Procurement <procurement@starlift.io>
Date: 2029-07-21T14:03:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Mutual onboarding: term tweak, burst runway, and ops playbook

Mina —

Thanks, this looks sensible. Week of Aug 12 is a little tight for us (several execs OOO). Would Aug 13 or Aug 20 work for Redwood?

Stakeholders: myself (Alex Day, Head of ML Ops), Priya Rao (Procurement), and Samir Patel (Platform). Priya is cc'd.

On procurement: we need a short checklist from your side listing: billing contact, PO process, and the expected DocuSign countersign timeline. Also please share SOC 2 and data-retention statements — our security team will review those.

Happy to run a 45-minute kickoff on the 13th if you have capacity.

Best,
Alex

On Jul 21, 2029, at 09:12 AM -07:00, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example> wrote:
> Hi Alex —
> 
> Thanks again for the productive renewal conversation last week....
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example>
To: Alex Day <alex.day@starlift.io>, Starlift Procurement <procurement@starlift.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example>
Date: 2029-07-21T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual onboarding: term tweak, burst runway, and ops playbook

Alex / Priya —

Aug 13 works for Redwood. I've tentatively held 45 minutes at 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET and will convert once you confirm.

Procurement checklist (quick):
- Billing contact: Priya Rao (please confirm PO number cadence)
- DocuSign: Redwood will send initial amendment; target countersign within 7 business days of execution
- Invoices: monthly; can switch to net-30 on request

Security artifacts: Evelyn is pulling SOC2 Type II summary, retention policy, and an audit-log sample. We expect to deliver those by Jul 24 end-of-day.

Action owners:
- Mina: kickoff and contract amendment (DocuSign)
- Ben: pricing impact for the 40% burst and term tweak
- Evelyn: security evidence and ops runbook

If you confirm Aug 13 I will send a calendar invite and the updated Mutual_Action_Plan_v1_edited.xlsx (small pricing and scheduling edits).

Thanks —
Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example>
Date: 2029-07-22T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual onboarding: term tweak, burst runway, and ops playbook

Mina / Evelyn —

Internal quick note (not in the Starlift thread):

- Pricing: the +40% burst for two months needs a short-term uplift clause rather than permanently changing the committed run-rate. Recommend a stepped pricing table in the amendment: steady-state + burst multiplier and a 3-month rollback clause.
- Discount: if Starlift signs a 12-month term (vs rolling), we can hold current list pricing and extend a 7% volume discount on the burst increment. Need legal to confirm wording.
- Capacity ops: SRE will add a cache warmup window and prefix caching to reduce token egress during spike handoffs.

I'll draft the pricing snippet and drop into the MAP by end of day Jul 23.

Ben
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example>
To: Alex Day <alex.day@starlift.io>, Starlift Procurement <procurement@starlift.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.example>
Date: 2029-07-24T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: QBR kickoff on Tue Aug 13 — calendar invite + docs

Alex / Priya / Samir —

Confirmed: Tue, Aug 13 at 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET for a 45-minute kickoff. Calendar invite sent here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=starlift-qbr-20290813

Attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1_edited.xlsx (pricing snippet added), QBR_agenda_final.docx.

What we'll cover in the kickoff (45m):
- 5m quick exec alignment
- 10m contract amendment and timing / PO/logistics
- 15m capacity plan (burst profile, throttles, runbook)
- 10m security artifacts and next steps
- 5m action-item assignment and follow-ups

Next actions for Priya: please share procurement PO cadence and the contact who will receive the DocuSign envelope. We'll send the amendment same day and target countersign within 7 business days.

Look forward to it —
Mina

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1_edited.xlsx, QBR_agenda_final.docx
